HoleLocation.description:
Enumeration of valid hole locations on a label.

Besides the eight atomic positions (four edges and four corners), two
group shorthands are accepted for the most common drilling patterns:
``corners`` (all four corner holes) and ``sides`` (the left and right
edge holes). Groups are expanded into their atomic members at schema
validation time (see :data:`HOLE_LOCATION_GROUPS`), so downstream
consumers only ever see the eight atomic locations.

Attributes:
    left: Hole on the left edge.
    right: Hole on the right edge.
    top: Hole on the top edge.
    bottom: Hole on the bottom edge.
    top_left: Hole at the top-left corner.
    top_right: Hole at the top-right corner.
    bottom_left: Hole at the bottom-left corner.
    bottom_right: Hole at the bottom-right corner.
    corners: Group shorthand for all four corner holes.
    sides: Group shorthand for the left and right edge holes.
HoleLocation.title: HoleLocation

HoleSpec.description:
Specification for a hole to be drilled in a label.

``location`` is the primary (and only required) field: the common case
is a standard 0.125" drill hole, which can be written as ``location``
alone. ``diameter`` is an optional override for non-standard sizes.

Group locations (``corners`` / ``sides``) are expanded into their
atomic member holes at validation time by the ``holes`` field
validator on :class:`LabelAttributes`; each expanded member inherits
this spec's ``diameter``.

Attributes:
    location: The position of the hole on the label edge. Group
        shorthands ``corners`` (all four corners) and ``sides``
        (left + right) are accepted and expanded into their members.
    diameter: The diameter of the hole in inches. Defaults to
        :data:`DEFAULT_HOLE_DIAMETER` (0.125"); must be positive.

location.description: Hole position on the label edge. Group shorthands 'corners' (all four corners) and 'sides' (left + right) expand into their atomic members at validation time.

diameter.description: Hole diameter in inches (default 0.125). A job-config.json 'hole_diameter' fills entries that omit this field.
diameter.title: Diameter

HoleSpec.title: HoleSpec

LabelShape.description:
Enumeration of valid label boundary shapes.

``rect`` (the default) is the historical behaviour: the label boundary is
the ``width`` x ``height`` rectangle, the packer packs that rectangle, and
every collision check measures the rectangle. ``round`` makes the boundary
an ellipse with semi-axes ``width / 2`` and ``height / 2`` -- a circle when
the two are equal -- which switches the label onto the adjacent
ellipse-packing pipeline (see :mod:`plt_optimizer.generate.ellipse_packer`)
and makes the collision checks measure the ellipse boundary.

Attributes:
    RECT: Rectangular boundary (default; the historical behaviour).
    ROUND: Elliptical boundary; a circle when ``width == height``.
LabelShape.title: LabelShape

LayoutMode.description:
Enumeration of plate fill-order preferences for bin packing.

``rectpack`` has no sort option that controls fill order directly (the
emergent order is a side effect of placement tie-breaking), so
``columns`` is realized by packing in a transposed frame with a
bottom-row fill algorithm and mapping every placement back into plate
space (see ``plt_optimizer.generate.layout``).

Attributes:
    ROWS: Fill the plate width first, then extend downward (row-major;
        the historical packing behaviour).
    COLUMNS: Fill the plate height first, then extend rightward
        (column-major; the default).
LayoutMode.title: LayoutMode

TextHAlignment.description:
Enumeration of valid horizontal text alignment modes for a text line.

The alignment anchors the rendered line within the label's inner content
area (label width minus both margins). ``left`` places the line's
left-most point precisely at the left margin; ``right`` places the
line's right-most point precisely at the right margin; ``center``
(the default) centers the line horizontally.

Attributes:
    LEFT: Left edge of the line sits at the left margin.
    CENTER: Line is horizontally centered within the inner content area.
    RIGHT: Right edge of the line sits at the right margin.
TextHAlignment.title: TextHAlignment

description:
Configured default values from ``job-config.json``.

Every field is optional; ``None`` (missing or explicit JSON ``null``)
means "no configured default". Field names and validation mirror the
corresponding :class:`~plt_optimizer.generate.schema.JobSpec` /
:class:`~plt_optimizer.generate.schema.PlateSpec` fields. Unknown keys
are rejected so typos in a shop config fail loudly.

Attributes:
    text_height: Default font height in inches.
    font: Default font name selecting the glyph outlines (PLT-extracted
        catalog ``font_name`` key or ``Fonts/`` TTF basename,
        case-insensitive). Unset falls back to the schema default
        (``ReliefSingleLineCAD-Regular``).
    character_spacing: Default extra spacing between characters (in
        inches). Unset falls back to the per-cutter derived default.
    line_spacing: Default extra spacing between text lines in inches.
    margin: Default label margin in inches. A spec-declared margin
        (job level, or on any label) suppresses the configured
        ``h_margin`` / ``v_margin`` injection.
    h_margin: Default horizontal (left/right) margin in inches; falls
        back to margin if unset. Not injected when the spec declares
        a margin.
    v_margin: Default vertical (top/bottom) margin in inches; falls
        back to margin if unset. Not injected when the spec declares
        a margin.
    hole_margin: Default hole margin in inches.
    min_hole_margin: Default collision-avoidance floor for the hole
        margin in inches.
    hole_text_collision_distance: Default engraved-stroke air gap in
        inches between text and drill-hole strokes.
    max_h_compress: Default maximum horizontal compression fraction
        in ``[0.0, 1.0]``.
    space_width_fraction: Default space advance fraction for
        PLT-extracted fonts (space = fraction * text_height +
        character_spacing). Unset falls back to 0.3.
    min_glyph_width: Default global minimum glyph advance width in
        inches for PLT-extracted fonts. The profile-envelope kerning
        floors each pair's advance at this value, capped by the left
        glyph's own width, so zero-width glyphs still reserve real air.
        Unset falls back to 0.0
        (pure profile-envelope kerning).
    kerning_window_fraction: Default kerning window for PLT-extracted
        fonts, as a fraction of the rendered text height in
        ``[0.0, 1.0]``. Unset falls back to 0.05; 0.0 reproduces the
        historical same-height maximum-penetration kerning.
    kerning_penetration_scale: Default multiplier on the detected
        windowed penetration for PLT-extracted fonts. Unset falls
        back to 1.0 (geometric).
    kerning_recession_scale: Default multiplier on a *recessed*
        (negative) detected penetration for PLT-extracted fonts.
        Unset falls back to 1.0 (geometric); 0.0 makes a recessed
        pair advance by nothing beyond the min_glyph_width floor.
    kerning_min_gap: Default extra air in inches added to every
        kerned pair advance for PLT-extracted fonts. Unset falls back
        to 0.0.
    fallback_advance_fraction: Default multiplier on the
        bounding-box-width fallback advance for PLT-extracted pairs
        without overlapping height. Unset falls back to 1.0.
    text_h_alignment: Default horizontal text alignment.
    holes: Default drill-hole list (injected at the job layer; group
        locations expand exactly like spec-provided holes).
    hole_diameter: Default drill-hole diameter in inches, applied to
        hole entries (config- or spec-provided) that omit
        ``diameter``.
    allow_rotation: Default bin-packing rotation permission.
    cutter_downsize: Default compression-driven cutter reduction
        permission. Unset falls back to True.
    max_cutter_downsizes: Default ceiling on successive cutter
        downsizings per text line. Unset falls back to 1; 0 disables
        the mechanism.
    text_chunk_mode: Default plate-space text optimization granularity.
    layout: Default plate fill order.
    type: Default label boundary shape ('rect' historical, 'round'
        ellipse/circle). Labels that omit it inherit the job value.
    plate_width: Default usable plate width in inches (plate layer).
    plate_height: Default usable plate height in inches (plate layer).
    left_clearance: Default plate left-edge clearance in inches
        (injected at the job layer; cascades onto plates that omit it).
    top_clearance: Default plate top-edge clearance in inches
        (injected at the job layer; cascades onto plates that omit it).
    auto_line_spacing_interline_to_top_bottom_ratio: Ratio controlling
        inter-line spacing relative to top/bottom margins when auto line
        spacing is enabled.
    auto_descending_character_adjustment: Default automatic
        descending-character relief permission. Unset falls back to True.
    descending_character_v_scale: Default deepest vertical downscale for a
        triggering descending glyph. Unset falls back to 0.5.
    descending_character_raise: Default deepest raise for a triggering
        descending glyph, as a fraction of its descender depth. Unset
        falls back to 0.7.
    descending_character_clearance: Default extra engraved-stroke air gap
        for descending-character relief, as a unitless factor of the stroke
        floor (required gap = floor * (1 + clearance)). Unset falls back
        to 0.0.
    descending_character_reciprocal_scale: Default deepest top-down
        downscale permitted for the colliding glyphs on the following line,
        in [0.2, 1.0] (1.0 = reciprocal downscaling forbidden). Unset falls
        back to 0.5.
    tool_options: Engraver tool options (header commands) metadata with
        HPGL command prefixes, types, units, dual defaults, and bounds.

description.description: Free-form comment field (mirrors tools.json); not a default.
description.title: Description

text_height.description: Default font height in inches (job layer).
text_height.title: Text Height

font.description: Default font name (job layer): a PLT-extracted font key or a Fonts/ TTF basename, case-insensitive. Canonicalized and validated when the job spec is built; unset falls back to the schema default font.
font.title: Font

character_spacing.description: Default extra spacing between characters in inches (job layer).
character_spacing.title: Character Spacing

line_spacing.description: Default extra spacing between text lines in inches (job layer).
line_spacing.title: Line Spacing

margin.description: Default label margin in inches (job layer). A spec-declared margin (job level, or on any label) suppresses the configured h_margin/v_margin injection.
margin.title: Margin

h_margin.description: Default horizontal margin (left/right) in inches; falls back to margin if unset (job layer). Not injected when the spec declares a margin (job level, or on any label).
h_margin.title: H Margin

v_margin.description: Default vertical margin (top/bottom) in inches; falls back to margin if unset (job layer). Not injected when the spec declares a margin (job level, or on any label).
v_margin.title: V Margin

hole_margin.description: Default hole margin in inches (job layer; required-when-unconfigured).
hole_margin.title: Hole Margin

min_hole_margin.description: Default collision-avoidance floor for the hole margin in inches (job layer; required-when-unconfigured).
min_hole_margin.title: Min Hole Margin

hole_text_collision_distance.description: Default engraved-stroke air gap in inches between text and drill-hole strokes (job layer; required-when-unconfigured).
hole_text_collision_distance.title: Hole Text Collision Distance

max_h_compress.description: Default maximum horizontal compression fraction in [0.0, 1.0] (job layer; required-when-unconfigured).
max_h_compress.title: Max H Compress

space_width_fraction.description: Default space advance fraction for PLT-extracted fonts (job layer): a space advances fraction * text_height + character_spacing. Unset falls back to 0.3.
space_width_fraction.title: Space Width Fraction

min_glyph_width.description: Default global minimum glyph advance width in inches for PLT-extracted fonts (job layer); clamps the profile-envelope kerning for zero-width glyphs. Unset falls back to 0.0.
min_glyph_width.title: Min Glyph Width

kerning_window_fraction.description: Default kerning window for PLT-extracted fonts (job layer) as a fraction of the rendered text height in [0.0, 1.0]; widens the envelope comparison so staggered pokes widen the advance. Unset falls back to 0.05.
kerning_window_fraction.title: Kerning Window Fraction

kerning_penetration_scale.description: Default kerning penetration multiplier for PLT-extracted fonts (job layer); over-kerns tight pairs proportionally. Unset falls back to 1.0.
kerning_penetration_scale.title: Kerning Penetration Scale

kerning_recession_scale.description: Default kerning recession multiplier for PLT-extracted fonts (job layer); scales a negative (recessed) detected penetration. Unset falls back to 1.0; 0.0 makes a recessed pair advance by nothing beyond the min_glyph_width floor.
kerning_recession_scale.title: Kerning Recession Scale

kerning_min_gap.description: Default extra kerning air in inches added to every kerned pair advance for PLT-extracted fonts (job layer). Unset falls back to 0.0.
kerning_min_gap.title: Kerning Min Gap

fallback_advance_fraction.description: Default fallback-advance multiplier for PLT-extracted glyph pairs without overlapping height (job layer). Unset falls back to 1.0.
fallback_advance_fraction.title: Fallback Advance Fraction

sc_scale.description: Default small-caps downscale applied to ASCII lowercase a-z by a ' SC' font variant (job layer; the lowercase character renders as the base font's uppercase glyph uniformly shrunk to this fraction of the cap height). Unset falls back to 0.7.
sc_scale.title: Sc Scale

supersubscript_downscale.description: Default downscale applied to a bare <sup>/<sub> markup run (job layer; the run's glyphs engrave uniformly shrunk to this fraction and the baseline shift derives from it, centering the shrunken glyph on its line -- superscript rises 1 - d/2 cap heights, subscript drops d/2). The argumented forms <sup:0.3>/<sub:-0.2> set the shift explicitly and apply no scaling. Unset falls back to 0.5.
supersubscript_downscale.title: Supersubscript Downscale

html_brackets.description: Default inline-markup delimiter pair (job layer): an even-length string whose first half is the left delimiter and second half the right ('<>' -> '<' + '>'). Unset falls back to '<>'.
html_brackets.title: Html Brackets

italic_angle.description: Default italic slant angle in degrees for <i> markup (job layer; PLT glyphs and TTF glyphs without a native italic face are sheared about the baseline). Bound to [0, 45]; 0 means upright. Unset falls back to 12.
italic_angle.title: Italic Angle

underline_offset.description: Default underline (<u>) extra air in inches (job layer): the underline centerline sits cutter diameter + this offset below the baseline (the engraved underline's top edge floats exactly this offset below the engraved baseline stroke). The break test is strictly horizontal, so a glyph breaks the underline where its ink crosses the underline's centerline; raising it lifts the underline clear of a glyph and stops it breaking. Unset falls back to 0.0.
underline_offset.title: Underline Offset

underline_break_clearance.description: Default underline (<u>) break clearance in inches (job layer): each cut is padded horizontally by 0.5 * cutter + this clearance (the half cutter is the glyph stroke's own half-width), so the engraved air between a descending glyph's stroke and the underline's cut edge is exactly this value. 0.0 = the cut sits at the ink. Unset falls back to 0.0.
underline_break_clearance.title: Underline Break Clearance

underline_break_spaces.description: Default underline (<u>) break-at-spaces flag (job layer): false (default) draws one continuous underline across the whole underlined run (spaces included, broken only by descending glyphs); true ends the underline at each space so every word gets its own underline and the inter-word space stays bare. Unset falls back to false.
underline_break_spaces.title: Underline Break Spaces

strikethrough_offset.description: Default strikethrough (<s>) height in inches above the baseline (job layer): the stroke (cut with the line's own text cutter) sits this many inches above the baseline, so 0.0 puts it on the baseline. Unlike the underline the stroke is never broken -- a descender punches through it. Unset (null) centres the stroke on the cap-band midline (half the rendered cap height).
strikethrough_offset.title: Strikethrough Offset

strikethrough_break_spaces.description: Default strikethrough (<s>) break-at-spaces flag (job layer): false (default) draws one continuous stroke across the whole struck run (spaces included); true ends the stroke at each space so every word gets its own strike and the inter-word space stays bare. Unset falls back to false.
strikethrough_break_spaces.title: Strikethrough Break Spaces

target_boldness_factor.description: Default multi-stroke target engraved stroke width as a fraction of text height (job layer; sizes the automatic cutter of multi-stroke/bold PLT fonts so the engraved passes total this width; inert on single-stroke fonts, TTF fonts, and lines with an explicit cutter_size). Unset falls back to 0.14.
target_boldness_factor.title: Target Boldness Factor

multistroke_overlap_ratio.description: Default multi-stroke minimum pass overlap ratio (job layer; the automatic cutter of a multi-stroke/bold PLT font is never smaller than pass_spacing / (1 - ratio), so adjacent engraved passes always overlap and no unengraved stripe appears). Unset falls back to 0.25.
multistroke_overlap_ratio.title: Multistroke Overlap Ratio

bold_boldness_multiplier.description: Default bold markup (<b>) boldness multiplier (job layer): the bold runs of a multi-stroke (bold) PLT font re-run the cutter ladder at target_boldness_factor * this multiplier (clamped to 0.30). Inert on single-stroke PLT and TTF fonts, where <b> steps to the next larger inventory cutter. Unset falls back to 1.5.
bold_boldness_multiplier.title: Bold Boldness Multiplier

holes.description: Default drill-hole list (job layer; group locations expand like spec holes).
holes.title: Holes

hole_diameter.description: Default drill-hole diameter in inches, applied to hole entries (config- or spec-provided) that omit 'diameter'.
hole_diameter.title: Hole Diameter

cutter_downsize.description: Default compression-driven cutter reduction permission (job layer; cascades line -> label -> job).
cutter_downsize.title: Cutter Downsize

max_cutter_downsizes.description: Default ceiling on successive cutter downsizings per text line (job layer; 0 disables the mechanism, 1 = at most one size down).
max_cutter_downsizes.title: Max Cutter Downsizes

cutter_downsize_global.description: Default per-label sharing of compression-driven cutter downsizes (job layer; a trigger line's swap applies to every eligible line of the same text_height in the same label).
cutter_downsize_global.title: Cutter Downsize Global

h_compress_global.description: Default per-label sharing of horizontal compression (job layer; a trigger line's compression scale applies to every eligible line of the same text_height in the same label).
h_compress_global.title: H Compress Global

optimize_line_content.description: Default word-level line-content reflow permission (job layer; consecutive enabled text lines redistribute their words to equalize rendered width, minimizing horizontal compression). Unset falls back to False.
optimize_line_content.title: Optimize Line Content

use_baseline_spacing.description: Default baseline-to-baseline line spacing permission (job layer; cascades label -> job, never text lines). True stacks a label's lines by baseline pitch so descenders hang into the gap and every gap reads as one uniform visual spacing; false stacks by rendered ink box. Unset falls back to true.
use_baseline_spacing.title: Use Baseline Spacing

v_center_by_content.description: Default vertical centering mode (job layer; cascades label -> job, never text lines). False (the default) centers a label's text block by its baseline-to-capline band, so the visible text is optically centered and descenders hang into the bottom margin for the descending-character relief to handle against the bottom border; true centers by rendered ink (historical), which charges the deepest descender to the block and makes lines with descenders ride high. Band centering is active only when auto_descending_character_adjustment is enabled. Unset falls back to false.
v_center_by_content.title: V Center By Content

auto_descending_character_adjustment.description: Default automatic descending-character relief permission (job layer; cascades label -> job, never text lines). True vertically downscales and raises a descending glyph only when a glyph on the following line comes within the required clearance (the engraved-stroke floor scaled by descending_character_clearance) of it; false leaves descenders exactly as rendered. Unset falls back to true.
auto_descending_character_adjustment.title: Auto Descending Character Adjustment

descending_character_v_scale.description: Default deepest vertical downscale permitted for a triggering descending glyph, in [0.2, 1.0] (job layer; 1.0 = downscaling forbidden, 0.5 = squeezed to half height, about the glyph's own baseline). Unset falls back to 0.5.
descending_character_v_scale.title: Descending Character V Scale

descending_character_raise.description: Default deepest raise permitted for a triggering descending glyph, as a fraction of its own descender depth in [0.0, 1.0] (job layer; 0.0 = no raising, 1.0 = lift until the glyph's lowest point sits exactly at the baseline). Unset falls back to 0.7.
descending_character_raise.title: Descending Character Raise

descending_character_clearance.description: Default extra engraved-stroke air gap demanded between a descending glyph and the glyph below it, as a unitless factor of the stroke floor at which the two strokes touch (required gap = floor * (1 + clearance); job layer). An explicit 0.0 is honored (only true touching triggers). Unset falls back to 0.0.
descending_character_clearance.title: Descending Character Clearance

descending_character_reciprocal_scale.description: Default deepest top-down downscale permitted for the would-be-colliding glyphs on the following line, in [0.2, 1.0] (job layer; 1.0 = reciprocal downscaling forbidden, 0.5 = squeezed to half height). The lower glyphs are scaled about their own lowest ink point, so their lowest point never moves; they share the relief with the descending glyph through the same ramp. Unset falls back to 0.5.
descending_character_reciprocal_scale.title: Descending Character Reciprocal Scale

optimize_line_content_max_lines.description: Default ceiling N on the consecutive lines a reflow group may use (job layer). Growth-only: the group starts at its existing line count and may gain lines up to N. Unset (null) means no growth.
optimize_line_content_max_lines.title: Optimize Line Content Max Lines

type.description: Default label boundary shape: 'rect' (historical) or 'round' (ellipse/circle). Job layer; labels that omit it inherit this.

plate_width.description: Default usable plate width in inches (plate layer + unbounded auto-allocation; never fills job-level label width).
plate_width.title: Plate Width

plate_height.description: Default usable plate height in inches (same layer rules as plate_width).
plate_height.title: Plate Height

left_clearance.description: Default plate left-edge clearance in inches (job layer; cascades onto plates that omit it).
left_clearance.title: Left Clearance

top_clearance.description: Default plate top-edge clearance in inches (same cascade as left_clearance).
top_clearance.title: Top Clearance

auto_line_spacing_interline_to_top_botto.description: Ratio controlling inter-line spacing relative to top/bottom margins when auto line spacing is enabled. Default 1.0 makes all gaps equal. Values > 1.0 increase inter-line spacing at the expense of top/bottom margins.
auto_line_spacing_interline_to_top_botto.title: Auto Line Spacing Interline To Top Bottom Ratio

tool_options.description: Optional engraver tool options (header commands) metadata. Keys are underscored header names (e.g., 'cutting_velocity', 'dwell_time'). Values are dicts with 'command' (HPGL prefix), 'type' (bool/int/float), 'units' (measurement unit string, e.g. 'in/sec'), 'default' (dual text/borders_holes dict), and for numeric types 'min'/'max' bounds. Populated by the extract_headers.py script from PLT reference files.
tool_options.title: Tool Options
